original_prompt: As an expert web/ux designer and god tier software engineer, review and revise the site to consolidate functionalities, properly write the site using a framework with an auth context and sign in process that leverages keycloak properly.  Sort the site content and functions appropriately.  We are a sort of Supabase for Openclaw with Sulcus and should appropriately provide clear functions with clear instructions and clear validations of what the functions achieve.  We must validate that our registration and sign in flows work properly locally, and remotely.  We must ensure all github references are properly pointed to the digitalforgeca not sulcus-labs organization.  Any emails should be pointed to 'apouriliaee+sulcus@gmail.com'.  Let's ensure we are listing all of our product offerings upon our site.  The Claude integration, the browser plugin and WASM and explain how it works and why it's amazing, the openclaw integration; let's ensure that we've submitted Sulcus to the openclaw hub for others to download.  Let's ensure we're pulling our subscription products directly from stripe instead of arbitrarily hardcoding this Teams for 99 all over the site.  Let's remove Teams altogether and call it something appropriate to fit the Sulcus (brain bits) theme in terms of being something that helps manage memories in one place.  Let's also ensure that when we sync things up in the cloud, our tenancy is well and separated and that no two people can see each others data in the system unless they wish it so.  We are giving people the ability to manage content in Sulcus cloud via our web portal and need to ensure that they can do that.  Let's generate a task list to track our progress hereon and orchestrate a team of claude cli invocations to perform the work.
